framing.descriptor: Fixed namespace pair and association2, u32contextcount0/1/4, that many explicit11-byte context references, anchorcount1 and anchor reference,67-byte trailer; total265+11*count.
framing.support: Typed6CCF prefix, stored flag bytes6/7, u32count0/1/2, count repeated19-byte entries (native reference plus opaque8-byte cache), reciprocal descriptor reference, opaque8-byte cache, zero8 trailer; total39+19*count. Counted source entries are not assigned action/geometry roles.
framing.context75: Typed50AEE raw48-byte cache, zero byte50, C46D namespace-context reference51, markers0001 at62, naming-link reference64. Namespace context must reproduce both descriptor UUIDs and association2.
framing.bounded_face: Four contexts explicitly join through namespace contexts to the same4B31 links, each of which names a typed edge recipe. No geometric ordering, closed boundary or face/ASM identity inferred.
framing.projected_edge: Cache naming link319 contains named StrongRefMetaType start/end vertex progenitor links; each links to a typed vertex recipe. Namespace context327 references a separate link325 and edge recipe326; link identity is not collapsed.
framing.empty_context: Five descriptors explicitly encode an empty context list; historical body/owner references remain available, without inventing a namespace-context record.

limitations: 46 remaining failures have only geometry/cache contexts:39 typed50AEE55,6 typed994C28,1 typedB0B103. This helper intentionally leaves them unresolved.
